listing.name: Admin XO (for Second-in-Command)
listing.summary: Adds a new officer class that buffs administration skills, allowing the player to personally manage more colonies and improve logistics.
listing.aiSummary: Adds a new officer class that buffs administration skills, allowing the player to personally manage more colonies and improve logistics.

description:
Admin XO

Download

Requires

Second-in-Command

Like running your own colonies? Unhappy that SiC means you'll always be worse than a hired administrator (or alpha core)? Me too! The Admin Executive Officer offers a way to buff your administration skills, meaning you can continue to run your colonies yourself. As well, it serves as a decent Logistics officer

(sorry to add to the pile of Logistics specialists)

, making it cheap and easy to putter around your colonies. With Nexerelin, outposts count too!

Officer Skills

Innate skill:

Multitasking

Can personally administer two additional colonies without penalties

Charismatic Leadership

Affects: governed colonies

Population growth increased by +10

+20% accessibility

Hyperspace Buoys

Affects: fleet

Controlled nav buoys in systems with your colonies affect hyperspace within 10 ly

Controlled nav buoys reduce terrain movement penalty by 50% (base) / 30% (makeshift)

Hyperspace Sensors

Affects: fleet

Controlled sensor relays in systems with your colonies affect hyperspace within 10 ly

Controlled sensor relays reduce detected-at range by 50% (base) / 30% (makeshift)

Supply Routes

Affects: fleet

Supply and fuel costs are reduced by up to 80% depending on how close you are to a colony, diminishing to zero at 10 light-years.

(Must have 2 skills from above)

Delegation

Affects: player

You can personally administer an additional four colonies without penalty.

Entrenchment

Affects: governed colonies

Increases ground defenses by x2

Increases fleet size by x1.5

Optimized Shipbuilding

Affects: all colonies

+50% maximum value of custom ship and weapon production per month

+20% ship quality factionwide

Affects: Fleet

Able to build 1 more permanent hullmod into ships you custom produce

(Must have 4 skills from above)

Vertical Integration

Affects: governed colonies

All industries supply 1 more unit of all the commodities they produce

All industries demand 1 less unit of all the commodities they require

Miniaturized Factories

Affects: governed colonies

+1 Industry Slot

-20% colony upkeep cost[close]

Doesn't require a new game - once added you should be able to find Admin officers occasionally in markets like with other SiC officers.

AI use disclaimerI originally wrote/coded this a year ago for myself. Text and images (re-tints of existing Starsector images) made by myself. Since deciding to publicly release it, I used Claude to polish and update the code.[close]

Many thanks to Lukas04 for creating such an awesome (and extensible) mod!

Many apologies also to him for creating an officer that he explicitly doesn't want.

aiDescription: Introduces the Admin Executive Officer, which provides innate skills for multitasking and charismatic leadership to boost population growth and accessibility. It also offers fleet-focused skills for hyperspace travel and supply routes, as well as colony-focused skills for shipbuilding and industry. This allows the player to continue running their own colonies effectively without relying on hired administrators.
